faqs.q: How do I track customer requests that come in by email?
faqs.a: Give each request a record with a status and a date to answer by, outside the inbox, and check the late ones every day. The desk does that, with fields for status, priority, kind and answer-by. [How to build a customer requests desk from your inbox](/guides/how-to-build-a-customer-requests-desk-from-your-inbox) covers it in any tool.

faqs.q: Does it read my Gmail inbox on its own?
faqs.a: No. The requests desk has no step that pulls email in by itself. You add each request by hand, paste a table or drop in a CSV, and Gmail is used only to send replies you approve.

faqs.q: Will it email customers without asking me?
faqs.a: No. Every reply waits in Needs you until you approve it, change it or decline it. The app will not build a step that sends to a customer without asking first.

faqs.q: What if one customer sends several requests?
faqs.a: Importing a file keeps one record per email address today, so extra requests from the same person would merge. Add the others by hand to keep each request on its own line.

faqs.q: How is this different from an AI agent that only replies to support email?
faqs.a: A reply-only AI agent answers and keeps nothing. The desk keeps each request as a record until it is solved, with status, priority, answer-by date and what was sent. If every question has a one-reply answer, replying alone is enough.

faqs.q: When do I need a help desk instead of a tracker?
faqs.a: When several people share the inbox and need to assign requests between them or report on response times. This desk is one list of requests, each with a status, priority and answer-by date, and a reply drafted for you to approve.

faqs.q: What does it cost to start?
faqs.a: 50agents is free to start. Tell Captain what you need, read the plan, and tap Build it. Nothing is built before that.

faqs.q: What if it sorts a request into the wrong kind or urgency?
faqs.a: Open the request on the desk and change the kind or priority yourself. Desk keeps lessons from your corrections, so later requests are sorted with them in mind.

faqs.q: Can I bring in requests I already have?
faqs.a: Yes. Paste a table or drop a CSV file and Captain matches the columns to the desk. Note that a file import keeps one request per email address.
